title: [E-Document Formats][OIOUBL] Migrate NAV PR 247162 into BCApps
summary: New OIOUBL e-document format reader for Denmark that parses OIOUBL XML invoices and credit notes into purchase staging tables, enabling structured e-document import using vendor VAT registration, GLN, or PEPPOL identifiers.
key_points: OIOUBL format handler codeunit implements IStructuredFormatReader to parse Invoice and CreditNote XML
Vendor lookup uses VAT registration number, GLN, or PEPPOL participant ID
Reuses public E-Document PEPPOL Utility helpers instead of private XML parsing
Includes structured integration tests and OIOUBL invoice/credit note test resources
Mirrors the same implementation pattern as existing PINT A-NZ handler
quote: Migrates internal NAV PR 247162 (OIOUBL structured E-Document reader) into BCApps
